title: Why Trump Still Believes (Wrongly) That Ukraine Hacked the D.N.C.

sentences.en: In the phone call at the center of the impeachment inquiry, President Trump asked Ukraine for two different investigations.
sentences.zh: 在弹劾调查核心的那通电话中，特朗普总统要求乌克兰进行两项不同的调查。

sentences.en: Scott Sheen on the unexpected story behind one of them.
sentences.zh: 斯科特·希恩将讲述其中一项调查背后意想不到的故事。

sentences.en: It's
sentences.zh: 今天是

sentences.en: Tuesday, November 26th.
sentences.zh: 11月26日，星期二。

sentences.en: We are joined right now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在连线。

sentences.en: It is our great pleasure to welcome the president of the United States, Donald Trump, calling in.
sentences.zh: 非常荣幸能欢迎美国总统唐纳德·特朗普打来电话。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump, good morning to you.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生，早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Good to have you on Fox and Friends today.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你今天能参加《福克斯与朋友们》节目。

sentences.en: So on Friday, President Trump called in to Fox and Friends, one of his favorite shows on Fox News.
sentences.zh: 周五，特朗普总统打入了他最喜欢的福克斯新闻节目《福克斯与朋友们》。

sentences.en: And what ensued was really a 53-minute stream of consciousness.
sentences.zh: 随后发生的一切简直是一场长达53分钟的意识流独白。

sentences.en: This was spying on my campaign, something that has never been done in the history of our country.
sentences.zh: 这是在监视我的竞选活动，这在我们国家历史上从未发生过。

sentences.en: They thought I was going to win, and they said, how could we stop them?
sentences.zh: 他们以为我会赢，于是他们说，我们该怎么阻止他们？

sentences.en: You know, a lot of people say deep state.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多人说“深层政府”。

sentences.en: I don't like to use the word deep state.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢用“深层政府”这个词。

sentences.en: I just say they're really bad, sick people.
sentences.zh: 我只说他们是真正糟糕、病态的人。

sentences.en: And one of the things he talked about was a theory that's really at the heart of the impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 他谈论的内容之一是一个处于弹劾调查核心的理论。

sentences.en: It's very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这非常有趣。

sentences.en: They have the server right from the DNC, Democratic National Committee.
sentences.zh: 他们拿到了民主党全国委员会的服务器。

sentences.en: Who has the server?
sentences.zh: 谁拿到了服务器？

sentences.en: The FBI went in and they told him, get out of here.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局进去时，他们告诉他，滚出去。

sentences.en: You're not kidding.
sentences.zh: 你不是在开玩笑吧。

sentences.en: We're not giving it to you.
sentences.zh: 我们不会把它交给你们。

sentences.en: They gave the server to CrowdStrike or whatever it's called, which is a country, which is a company owned by a very wealthy Ukrainian.
sentences.zh: 他们把服务器交给了CrowdStrike或者叫什么名字的公司，那是一家由一位非常有钱的乌克兰人拥有的公司。

sentences.en: And it was the same theory that he brought up with the president of Ukraine, President Zelensky, in this famous phone call on July 25th.
sentences.zh: 这正是他在7月25日那通著名的电话中向乌克兰总统泽连斯基提出的理论。

sentences.en: The theory, the false theory, is that Ukraine and not Russia was responsible for the hacking of the 2016 election and that Ukraine was assisted in this
sentences.zh: 这个理论，这个虚假的理论是：是乌克兰而不是俄罗斯应对2016年大选的黑客攻击负责，而且乌克兰是在

sentences.en: by a company called CrowdStrike.
sentences.zh: 一家名为CrowdStrike的公司的协助下完成的。

sentences.en: Scott, what would make the president believe this theory and mention this company by name?
sentences.zh: 斯科特，是什么让总统相信这个理论并点名这家公司？

sentences.en: Well, let's start with the undisputed facts.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我们从无可争议的事实开始说起。

sentences.en: Back in the spring of 2016, of course, it was the middle of the presidential race.
sentences.zh: 回到2016年春天，当然，那是总统竞选的中期。

sentences.en: And the Democratic National Committee discovers that its computers have been hacked.
sentences.zh: 民主党全国委员会发现其计算机遭到黑客攻击。

sentences.en: So they call their cybersecurity contractor CrowdStrike.
sentences.zh: 于是他们致电他们的网络安全承包商CrowdStrike。

sentences.en: And CrowdStrike is a California company that was co-founded by a fellow who immigrated as a child from Russia and really one of the top cybersecurity companies out there.
sentences.zh: CrowdStrike是一家加州公司，由一位儿时从俄罗斯移民过来的伙伴共同创立，确实是顶尖的网络安全公司之一。

sentences.en: And the Democratic National Committee asked them to come to Washington and examine these computers and basically do what any cybersecurity company does,
sentences.zh: 民主党全国委员会请他们来到华盛顿检查这些计算机，基本上做任何网络安全公司都会做的事情，

sentences.en: which is kick out the hackers, kind of clean up the computer servers, and make sure the organization can keep functioning.
sentences.zh: 那就是把黑客赶出去，清理计算机服务器，并确保该组织能够继续运作。

sentences.en: So essentially, CrowdStrike and the DNC report this to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，CrowdStrike和民主党全国委员会向联邦调查局报告了此事。

sentences.en: Hacking is, of course, a crime.
sentences.zh: 黑客攻击当然是犯罪。

sentences.en: So the FBI begins its own investigation.
sentences.zh: 因此，联邦调查局开始了他们自己的调查。

sentences.en: And CrowdStrike is in communication the whole time with the FBI.
sentences.zh: CrowdStrike全程与联邦调查局保持沟通。

sentences.en: And so they're essentially working alongside each other and zeroing in, in part, on who did it by looking at the, essentially, the fingerprints
sentences.zh: 所以他们基本上是在协同工作，并通过查看那些潜入计算机系统的窃贼留下的指纹，即特定黑客组织留下的所谓蛛丝马迹，

sentences.en: of the burglars who broke into the computer system, the sort of telltale signs that particular hacking groups leave behind.
sentences.zh: 部分锁定了肇事者。

sentences.en: And all those telltale signs were pointing to Russia and in particular to hackers who work for the Russian government.
sentences.zh: 而所有这些蛛丝马迹都指向俄罗斯，特别是为俄罗斯政府工作的黑客。

sentences.en: And they did it, American intelligence agencies conclude, to assist Donald Trump and especially to damage Hillary Clinton in this presidential race.
sentences.zh: 美国情报机构得出结论，他们这样做是为了协助唐纳德·特朗普，尤其是为了在这次总统竞选中损害希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: So where does this Trump theory that he talks about on Fox News that becomes part of the impeachment inquiry, where does that intersect with the story that you just laid out, the
sentences.zh: 那么，特朗普在福克斯新闻上谈论并成为弹劾调查一部分的理论，与你刚才陈述的那个

sentences.en: undisputed fact story?
sentences.zh: 无可争议的事实故事，两者在哪里产生了交集？

sentences.en: Well, President Trump takes the players that exist in real life, but in each case sort of distorts the facts.
sentences.zh: 嗯，特朗普总统采用了现实中存在的参与者，但在每种情况下都扭曲了事实。

sentences.en: And the main purpose of the distortion seems to be to bring Ukraine in at each point.
sentences.zh: 而这种扭曲的主要目的似乎是在每一个环节都把乌克兰牵扯进来。

sentences.en: So he says that CrowdStrike, this California company, is Ukrainian, owned by a rich
sentences.zh: 所以他说CrowdStrike这家加州公司是乌克兰的，由一位富有的

sentences.en: Ukrainian.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人拥有。

sentences.en: Not true.
sentences.zh: 这不是真的。

sentences.en: He says the FBI dropped the ball on this investigation and turned everything over to CrowdStrike and let them essentially take over.
sentences.zh: 他说联邦调查局在这项调查中失职，把一切都交给了CrowdStrike，让他们基本上接管了调查。

sentences.en: Not true.
sentences.zh: 这不是真的。

sentences.en: And he says that as a result of
sentences.zh: 他说，由于CrowdStrike接管了调查，

sentences.en: CrowdStrike taking over because he thinks CrowdStrike is a Ukrainian company, the server, the DNC server that he's very focused on has somehow ended up in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 因为他认为CrowdStrike是一家乌克兰公司，所以他非常关注的那个民主党全国委员会的服务器，不知何故最终流落到了乌克兰。

sentences.en: It's hidden in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 它被藏在乌克兰。

sentences.en: So the gist of what he's saying to the American public is you can't believe what the FBI told you about the hacking of the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 所以他向美国公众传达的要点是：你不能相信联邦调查局关于2016年大选黑客攻击的说法。

sentences.en: In fact, the FBI messed up this investigation and all signs point not to Russia, but to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 事实上，联邦调查局搞砸了这项调查，所有迹象都指向乌克兰，而不是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: So this is a pretty unified theory that CrowdStrike is Ukrainian.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个相当统一的理论，即CrowdStrike是乌克兰公司。

sentences.en: CrowdStrike gets the computer servers.
sentences.zh: CrowdStrike拿到了计算机服务器。

sentences.en: CrowdStrike places them in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: CrowdStrike把它们放在了乌克兰。

sentences.en: But none of it is true.
sentences.zh: 但这一切都不是真的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Why does Trump want
sentences.zh: 为什么特朗普想要

sentences.en: Ukraine to be involved and not Russia?
sentences.zh: 乌克兰参与进来，而不是俄罗斯？

sentences.en: So Trump first mentioned this false theory about Ukraine and
sentences.zh: 特朗普第一次提到关于乌克兰和

sentences.en: CrowdStrike back in April of 2017?
sentences.zh: CrowdStrike的虚假理论是在2017年4月？

sentences.en: It was in the middle of an interview with the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 那是在接受美联社采访时。

sentences.en: It was the early months of his presidency.
sentences.zh: 那是他总统任期的头几个月。

sentences.en: And I think in some ways he was still smarting from the implication that he had had Russian help and that maybe his victory was not legitimate.
sentences.zh: 我认为在某种程度上，他仍然对“他得到了俄罗斯的帮助，他的胜利可能不合法”这一暗示感到痛苦。

sentences.en: And I think he's very worried about that.
sentences.zh: 我认为他非常担心这一点。

sentences.en: You see lots of signs of his concern about that.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到很多他对此感到担忧的迹象。

sentences.en: So if he can somehow
sentences.zh: 所以如果他能以某种方式

sentences.en: disprove or divert attention from the notion that Russia helped him win, he's psychologically and politically a lot better off.
sentences.zh: 反驳或转移人们对“俄罗斯帮助他获胜”这一观念的注意力，他在心理上和政治上都会好过得多。

sentences.en: And Ukraine is sort of the perfect fall guy in this story.
sentences.zh: 而乌克兰在这个故事中算是完美的替罪羊。

sentences.en: Russia and
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯和

sentences.en: Ukraine are at war.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰处于战争状态。

sentences.en: And Ukraine, while I don't think it's fair to say that Ukraine interfered in the election, it is true that a few Ukrainian officials criticized Trump on the campaign trail,
sentences.zh: 虽然我不认为说乌克兰干预了选举是公平的，但确实有几位乌克兰官员在竞选期间批评过特朗普，

sentences.en: things that he was saying, and in some cases praised Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 批评过他说的话，在某些情况下还称赞过希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: So if he can shift the blame from
sentences.zh: 所以如果他能把责任从

sentences.en: Russia to Ukraine, he can essentially burnish his victory and remove this cloud over his presidency
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯转移到乌克兰，他基本上就能美化自己的胜利，消除笼罩在他总统任期上的这片阴云，

sentences.en: and make the claim that his victory is all the greater because not only did no foreign actor help
sentences.zh: 并声称他的胜利更加伟大，因为不仅没有外国势力帮助

sentences.en: him, but he had to overcome interference by these hostile Ukrainians who, as he put it once, tried to take me down.
sentences.zh: 他，而且他还必须克服这些敌对的乌克兰人的干预，正如他曾经说过的，他们“试图打倒我”。

sentences.en: So in this theory, which, as you've just said, is not true, but in this theory, he's not the beneficiary of an election surreptitiously aided by Russia.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个理论中，正如你刚才所说，这不是真的，但在该理论中，他不是俄罗斯秘密援助的选举受益者。

sentences.en: He is the victor over an obstacle course laid out by Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他是战胜了乌克兰设置的重重障碍的胜利者。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it wasn't until this same false theory about crowd strike in Ukraine turned up in the White House reconstruction of his July call to the president of Ukraine that everybody
sentences.zh: 所以直到这个关于CrowdStrike和乌克兰的虚假理论出现在白宫关于他与乌克兰总统7月通话的重构记录中时，大家

sentences.en: began focusing on it.
sentences.zh: 才开始关注它。

sentences.en: So everybody asked, why did Trump come to believe that Ukraine and not Russia was somehow involved in the hacking?
sentences.zh: 所以每个人都在问，为什么特朗普会相信乌克兰而不是俄罗斯以某种方式参与了黑客攻击？

sentences.en: And where did this bogus theory come from?
sentences.zh: 这个荒谬的理论是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: But I couldn't find the origin of that story.
sentences.zh: 但我找不到那个故事的起源。

sentences.en: And so it remained a little bit of a mystery.
sentences.zh: 所以它仍然是一个小小的谜团。

sentences.en: And then new evidence came to light.
sentences.zh: 然后新的证据浮出水面。

sentences.en: And it turned out that its origin was even more nefarious than we had imagined.
sentences.zh: 结果发现它的起源比我们想象的还要邪恶。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Scott, what have you found out about where this theory actually came from?
sentences.zh: 那么斯科特，你发现了这个理论到底是从哪里来的吗？

sentences.en: So Trump's false theory came, it turns out, not from some wacky website or from Twitter.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，特朗普的虚假理论并非来自某个古怪的网站或推特。

sentences.en: It may have actually originated with the Russians.
sentences.zh: 它实际上可能起源于俄罗斯人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: How would that have worked?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: So we learned this new information from FBI documents obtained by BuzzFeed, the news organization, under the Freedom of Information Act.
sentences.zh: 我们从新闻机构BuzzFeed根据《信息自由法》获得的联邦调查局文件中了解到了这一新信息。

sentences.en: And it turns out that Trump heard from his campaign chairman, Paul Manafort, that Ukraine and not Russia might be responsible for the hacking.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，特朗普从他的竞选主席保罗·马纳福特那里听说，乌克兰而不是俄罗斯可能应对黑客攻击负责。

sentences.en: And Manafort, apparently, according to these new FBI documents, heard this from Konstantin
sentences.zh: 而根据这些新的联邦调查局文件，马纳福特显然是从康斯坦丁·

sentences.en: Kalimnik, who was an associate of his, who was a dual Russian-Ukrainian national with very close ties to Russian intelligence.
sentences.zh: 基利姆尼克那里听说的，他是马纳福特的合伙人，是一位与俄罗斯情报部门有密切联系的俄罗斯-乌克兰双重国籍人士。

sentences.en: So a man with ties to Russian intelligence, who works closely with Paul Manafort, Donald
sentences.zh: 所以一个与俄罗斯情报部门有联系、与2016年唐纳德·

sentences.en: Trump's campaign manager in 2016, gives the information to Manafort.
sentences.zh: 特朗普竞选经理保罗·马纳福特密切合作的人，把信息给了马纳福特。

sentences.en: And our understanding goes, Manafort would have then passed that on to Trump.
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，马纳福特随后会将此信息传递给特朗普。

sentences.en: And if what we know about Russia and the way it handles information is true, this would have potentially been a deliberate misinformation campaign.
sentences.zh: 如果我们对俄罗斯及其处理信息方式的了解是正确的，这可能是一场蓄意的虚假信息宣传活动。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because it was certainly in Russia's interest to shift the blame for interference in the 2016 election away from its intelligence agencies to anywhere, but to its enemy, Ukraine,
sentences.zh: 因为将2016年大选干预的责任从其情报机构转移到任何地方，只要不是转移到其敌人乌克兰身上，这当然符合俄罗斯的利益，

sentences.en: that's all the better.
sentences.zh: 那就再好不过了。

sentences.en: And why would Manafort believe this man who's telling him that it's Ukraine, not Russia, behind this meddling?
sentences.zh: 为什么马纳福特会相信这个告诉他幕后黑手是乌克兰而不是俄罗斯的人？

sentences.en: Well, Manafort, folks might remember, was a longtime political operative in Ukraine, but he was working in Ukraine on behalf of a pro-Russia political party.

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，和我一起，莎拉·凯尼格，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
